text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae achieved the historic 
milestone of the most GⅠ victories in 
history! Having forged a legend, she was 
showered with praise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon entrusted her with the dream 
of winning the dirt international G1 race 
in Dubai, and Hokko Tarumae vowed to see 
that long-cherished wish fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing her run, Hokko Tarumae 
returned to the Trainer's side. The 
Trainer's welcoming words struck a deep 
chord in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she expressed her heartfelt gratitude. 
To her fans, her rivals, and her 
"hometown"— it was thanks to everyone that 
she could stand here today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later. Hokko Tarumae, named the URA Best 
Dirt Umamusume, finally achieved her 
long-awaited dream of co-starring with 
Smart Falcon at a commemorative event!
